mapper.sql: sp.id, sp.user_id AS userId, sp.real_name AS realName, sp.school_id AS schoolId, sp.grade, sp.subjects_needed AS subjectsNeeded, sp.free_time AS freeTime, sp.personality_desc AS personalityDesc, sp.profile_status AS profileStatus, sp.bind_admin_id AS bindAdminId, sp.audit_status AS auditStatus, sp.audit_time AS auditTime, sp.audit_notes AS auditNotes, sp.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username, u.phone, sc.name AS schoolName FROM student_profile sp JOIN user u ON sp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN school sc ON sp.school_id = sc.id WHERE sp.bind_admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY sp.update_time DESC
